# TitanCurse on concurrent double and triple Juice Spike

Sample18 Ring4 release187 reaches18 valid native inputs, then cannot publish
at turn4. TitanCurse left in hand adds its spell-cost upgrade to both Spike12
(double Juice) and Spike25 (triple Juice). The latter signature is calibrated;
the former is explicitly rejected by the post-upgrade guard.

Two independent19-input observations preserve those18 inputs, then EndTurn4
with the curse unplayed. Both Spikes receive one native TitanCurse_Upgrade
(f37fb903-28d6-4d49-b50e-9226f4854816), temporary cost+1, at turn5. The original
boundary has no forecast; release189's independent replay matches the complete
state, forecast and RNG across all inputs. Four detached EndTurn branches match
without changing their parent. Unknown ID/asset, cost+2 and damage+1 remain
unsupported. This admits the exact already captured cost payload on the
separately calibrated double owner; other temporary upgrades are still gaps.
